topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's core themes on cancer evolution and outlines the expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how somatic mutations and epigenetic alterations drive early clonal expansion and tumor evolution.

topics.label: The cancer stem cell model and cell of origin
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the role of tissue hierarchy and evidence for cancer stem cell models in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how inflammatory signals and stromal microenvironments promote malignant transformation and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Technologies for analyzing tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: It reviews genomic and spatial profiling technologies used to map tumor heterogeneity and cellular interactions in tissue specimens.

topics.label: Unified synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes genetic, cellular, and microenvironmental factors into a comprehensive model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
